verdict.rationale: HumanLayer documents a 'Connect GitHub' integration, but it is described as creating tasks from issues and linking artifacts back. Draft PR creation from a GitHub tab implies some repository connectivity. Code access otherwise comes from the host machine the agent runs on, plus workspace config files, rather than a one-click repo grant. Missing for 10: evidence of a one-click install or app flow granting repo access, documentation of repository permission scoping, and hands-on confirmation that setup is simple.
